_doc: Forces of nature and hardships: when they happen, how strong they are, and what the tribe is told. Times are seconds unless named *_days (one day is 90 s). [a, b] pairs are random ranges. Texts are English translation keys. Read by hazards.gd and nature.gd; see docs/CONFIG.md.

news.alert: Spring returns. The berries ripen again, and the herds come back.
Summer. Watch the food stores - they spoil faster in the heat.
Autumn. Winter comes in two days: gather food and wood, and keep the fires lit.
Winter has come! No berries, no harvest, the herds have moved south, and the cold can kill.

seasons._doc: Per season [spring, summer, autumn, winter]: berries (bush yield), yields (food from each building), spoil (rot speed of stored food), hunger.

cold._doc: Damage per second away from a fire: night (without furs), winter (by day it is winter * day), weather adds its own 'cold'/'cold_hide'. Hide = the Hide Tailoring tech.

weather._doc: Effects while a weather lasts: speed, work, sight (multipliers), wet (puts out fires faster, slows their spread), dry (fires and lightning catch more easily), berries (bush yield instead of the season's), crops (multiplies building food, except crops_spare), cold/cold_hide (extra cold damage), deadly_cold (the cold can kill). era_mult: [age 1, 2, 3] multiplies the chance (a late frost and a blight grow likelier as the tribe lives by its fields).

storm.name: Thunderstorm
storm.alert: A thunderstorm rolls over the land.

drought.name: Drought
drought.alert: Drought: berries wither and the fields go dry.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.warn: The sky turns white-grey - a blizzard is coming! Get everyone to the fires.
blizzard.alert: Blizzard! Anyone far from a fire will freeze.

late_frost.name: Late Frost
late_frost.alert: A late frost: the young crops and the berry blossom die in the night.
late_frost.done: The frost lifts. What was sown must grow again.

blight.name: Blight
blight.alert: Blight: the crops rot on the stalk.

wolves.alert: Wolves howl in the dark - a pack of %d is hunting near the village!

tiger_raids.alert: A hungry saber-tooth has left its den and is stalking toward the village!

sickness._doc: Every roll_every s a chance someone falls ill: base, + winter, + crowding over 80% of the housing, + hungry while the stores hold less than a meal each, growing by hungry_per_hour for every game hour they have been that low (up to hungry_max); fed again, that count eases back hungry_ease times as fast as it grew. Past rules.json beds.crowd_at of the beds taken it also spreads more easily: x (1 + crowd_spread x how far past). A hungry camp's sickness strikes the hungriest first, spreads hungry_spread times as easily to someone hungrier than recover.hungry_below, and after hungry_force_hours of hunger the director can no longer hold it back (the tribe brought it on itself); hungry_alert then names it.
sickness.hungry_alert: %s has fallen ill: hunger has weakened the camp, and the fever finds the weakest first.

recover._doc: A sickness lasts 'time' seconds, sped up or slowed by each factor. healer: tended by a healer (with the society model on, someone at the heal job, at least healer_lore, within healer_radius: config/society.json heal; else anyone with that lore near).

sickness.alert: %s has fallen ill with a coughing fever. Keep the sick warm - it spreads.

famine.alert: FAMINE! The stores are empty and the tribe is starving. Hunt, fish, forage - now.
famine.warn: Food is running low - about a day's worth left for %d mouths.
famine.remember: went hungry in the famine of Year %d

lightning.hit_alert: Lightning strikes %s - and they live! The sky has touched them.
lightning.hit_remember: was struck by lightning on Day %d and lived - touched by the sky
lightning.building_alert: Lightning sets the %s on fire! It must be rebuilt.

house_fire._doc: A building that catches fire (nat.set_alight: lightning, wildfire, a raider's torch) burns down; after leap_secs the fire may leap to each flammable building of ours (hazards: wildfire; never a wall ring) whose edge is within `gap` of its edge, with `chance` (times wet_mult in rain or winter, drought_mult in a drought), and on from there: a packed camp burns together, a spread one does not. The buildings it leaps to are left at `left` of their work.

wildfire.log: The wildfire burns out: %d trees are lost. In time, berries will sprout in the ashes.

great_flood._doc: The Great Flood (sim.flood_strike), when the flood dilemma's warning comes true: the share of the food stores it washes away; people within hit_radius of a river are hurt by hit_damage of their health; buildings within building_radius are knocked down to rebuild of their work.

flood.warn: The river is rising! Get away from the banks.
flood.log: The river falls back. The silt it left will feed the riverside fields.
flood.remember: saw the river flood in the spring of Year %d

volcano.warn: The ground trembles. Black smoke pours from the Fire Mountain.
volcano.alert: The Fire Mountain erupts! Fire runs down its slopes and ash darkens the sky.
volcano.remember: saw the Fire Mountain erupt on Day %d

earthquake.alert: The earth shakes!%s A rockslide bares new stone in the hills.
earthquake.remember: felt the earth shake on Day %d

eclipse.start_log: A shadow bites into the sun...
eclipse.title: The Sun Is Devoured
eclipse.speaker: best:lore
eclipse.text: At midday a black mouth eats the sun. Birds fall silent, the air turns cold, and stars come out in the day. The people cry out and look to you.

options.label: Beat the drums
options.desc: Drive off the sky-beast with drums and shouting. (+devotion, the tribe grows more martial)

do.remember: beat the drums to drive the sky-beast from the sun on Day %d

options.result: The drums thunder and the people howl at the sky. Slowly, the beast spits out the sun.

options.label: Offer food to the sky
options.desc: Feed the hungry sky. (+devotion, the tribe grows more spiritual)

do.remember: offered food to the devoured sun on Day %d

options.result: The offering burns on the fire. The sky is fed, and gives the sun back.

options.label: Let %s read the omen
options.desc: Only a wise shaman (Lore 3+) or the knowledge of the Megalithic Totems can calm the people - otherwise they panic.

do.remember: read the omen of the devoured sun and calmed the tribe on Day %d

options.result: %s points to the old marks on the totems: "The sun has been eaten before, and always it returns." The people grow calm, and learn.

else_do.remember: hid in terror when the sun was devoured on Day %d

options.else_result: %s has no answer. Panic! The people drop their work and hide in their huts until the light returns.

winters._doc: The kinds of winter (hazards.gd, make_it_fun B1/B2). When autumn begins the director picks the coming kind (director.json winter); it stays hidden, and the autumn dilemma (dilemmas.json autumn) quotes signs_read signs, each true to the kind with chance sign_truth, else a sign of another kind. In winter the kind's effects multiply: weather {kind: chance mult}, cold (cold damage), wolves (pack chance), spoil (stored food rot), food (yields of farms, docks and pens), herds_leave (share of deer that migrate, x0.5). pack_extra: wolves added to each pack. signature: the director weights (blizzard, wolves...) that are this winter's own: the director lets them past its tension cap unless the tribe is in distress. The tribe's preparation (the prepare action, stats in prepare_stats) multiplies the same stats. name and arrive are said when the winter comes.

white.name: A Hard White Winter
white.arrive: The snow comes early and deep, and the blizzards follow one on another.
signs: The geese flew south early, and low.
The beavers have built their lodges high.
The deer grew their winter coats before the leaves fell.

wolf.name: A Wolf Winter
wolf.arrive: The packs come down from the hills. Every night the wolves are closer.
signs: Wolves were heard howling in daylight.
The deer keep close together, even at noon.
Gnawed bones were found by the river.

lean.name: A Lean Winter
lean.arrive: The herds are gone, the river is sullen, and the stores are all the tribe has.
signs: The acorns are few and small this year.
The herds are thin and restless.

mild.name: A Mild Winter
mild.arrive: The winter comes gently: grey skies, a little snow, and quiet nights.
signs: The bees are still busy at the last flowers.
The geese linger on the river.
The mornings are warm and wet.
